input.quote: (ii) the Service will perform in all material respects to industry standards;
input.rationale: Kubient gives a set of ongoing warranties in paragraph 9(b) — Service performance to industry standards, services free from errors materially affecting utility, no malicious code and compliance with applicable Laws — and the paragraph 13 disclaimer expressly preserves them ("except for the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement"). The ongoing Service warranty runs for the Term and so exceeds the 30-day services floor. However, the Agreement contains no conformance-to-documentation warranty for the Auction Platform or any software (the word "documentation" appears nowhere), and there is no warranty remedy at all — no repair, replacement or refund anywhere in the document. That fails two material fallback elements, so we propose the shortest fallback-level cure: a 90-day software conformance warranty and a repair/replace/refund remedy inserted at the end of Kubient's warranties. We have not pushed for the preferred 12-month software period or the professional-and-workmanlike formulation, which we note only as short of preferred.

proposal.summary: Add a 90-day software-to-documentation conformance warranty and repair/replace/refund remedy to Kubient's warranties
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Kubient's warranties contain no conformance-to-documentation commitment and no warranty remedy, so we add the fallback position: a 90-day software conformance warranty plus repair, replacement or refund. The existing ongoing Service performance warranty already exceeds the 30-day services floor, so we leave it untouched.

ops.text: (xii) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, the Auction Platform and any other software provided hereunder will conform in all material respects to the documentation provided by Kubient. For breach of the warranties in this paragraph 9(b), Kubient shall, at Customer's election, repair or replace the non-conforming software or Service, or refund the fees paid for the non-conforming software or Service.
